asunto.base: Verification request pending on your account
asunto.urgencia: Did you try to sign in? A verification is waiting
asunto.urgencia+erratas: VERIFICATION REQUIRED - access request on your account

titular.urgencia: {{saludo}}, is it you trying to sign in?

entradilla.base: Two-step verification has been requested to access {{aplicacion}}. If it was you, approve the request with code {{codigo}}.
entradilla.urgencia: Someone is trying to sign in to your account from {{ubicacion}} and the verification is waiting. If it is not you, do not approve it.
entradilla.urgencia+erratas: Several verification attempts have been detected on your account. You must confirm your identity to stop them.

detalle.base: If you did not sign in, approve nothing and review the account from the link. Nobody from support will ever ask you to approve a request over the phone.
detalle.urgencia: If these requests keep coming and you did not trigger them, someone has your password. Change it from the link.
detalle.urgencia+erratas: Access your account to review the requests and block the unauthorised attempts.

urgencia.base: The request expires on its own after 5 minutes if nobody approves it.
urgencia.urgencia: Every request that arrives and is not yours is an attempt to sign in with a password they already know.
urgencia.urgencia+erratas: WARNING: 7 attempts have been recorded in the last few minutes. Your account is at risk.

cta.urgencia: That was not me, review my account
